title: Applebee's
description: Join us at Applebee's of Monroe for our Dine to Donate evening! Mention Monroe County Humane Society and 15% of your bill supports shelter medical treatments.

title: Applebee's Flapjack Breakfast
description: All-you-can-eat pancake breakfast served by our shelter volunteer team at Applebee's. Tickets $10 at the door; all proceeds benefit shelter animals.

title: Cars & Critters Car Show
description: Classic cars, trucks, motorcycles, adoptable pets, barbecue, and awards! Family fun in the park supporting our humane shelter.

title: Casa de Margarita
description: Fiesta for the animals! Casa de Margarita hosts an authentic dinner night donating a portion of all dining proceeds to Monroe Humane.

title: Dine to Donate Series
description: Our monthly community dining partnership across Monroe County restaurants. Good food for a great shelter cause.

title: Dirty Birdie
description: Our premier summer scramble golf outing, raffles, skins, dinner buffet, and prizes benefiting Monroe animals.

title: Humane Society Golf Outing
description: 18-hole scramble tournament at Sandy Creek Golf Course. Hole sponsors, lunch at the turn, and awards banquet.

title: Humane Society Annual Benefit
description: Heartwarming rescue milestones, community leadership awards, dinner, and silent auction supporting shelter upgrades.

title: Jerry's Frenchtown Bar
description: 20% donation night at Jerry's Frenchtown Bar! Live music, raffle baskets, and community pet advocates coming together.

title: Michigan Bar & Grill Benefit
description: Community dinner benefit with great food, door prizes, and donation match for emergency feline and canine care.

title: Mugsy's Sports Grille
description: Mugsy's Heart Sale & Burger Night! Grab a bite and purchase a memorial heart to display on Mugsy's community board.

title: Pavlov's Brewing Pint Night
description: $1 from every craft pint sold supports the Monroe County Humane Society emergency medical fund.

title: Wheels for Wags & Whiskers
description: Annual charity motorcycle run and trunk-or-treat pet parade through Monroe County, ending with hot cider and adoption stories.
